> 第19章 还是穷啊（第1页）
聚气丹不但可以直接拿来修炼，而且可以恢复体内的五行灵气，有时候比灵石还好用。
陈长生拿出聚气丹数了170枚过去，那修士放在鼻孔下面嗅了嗅满意点点头，陈长生炼制的聚气丹虽然是下品，但也是一等一的成色。
如果材料好点，陈长生相信能够炼制出品质更好的。
陈长生拿了丹炉，又拿了丹方神念一扫很是满意的收了起来。
聚气丹和辟谷丹这两种丹方都是最普通的丹方，稍微有点门路的都能搞到手，得到相对容易些，其它的丹方想要得到只怕很难了。
陈长生甚至还看见有人售卖筑基丹的，这让他的呼吸都变得急促起来，他要不久就要筑基，如果有一枚筑基丹的话，成功率将会大大增加。
不过陈长生一看那价格顿时像是泄了气的皮球。
一枚筑基丹居然需要十万下品灵石，实在是恐怖如斯啊。
没想到筑基丹的价格这么高，自己要是能够炼制出来筑基丹，岂不是要发达了。
一般能够突破大境界的丹药价格都很高，而且这筑基丹乃是二品丹药，价格自然高的离谱。
还有一种能够突破瓶颈的丹药价格也很高。
陈长生越逛越是眼热，不过这价格也很离谱，这只是最普通的飞剑，价格也需要五万下品灵石。
也就是说他在废丹房忙活这么久，还不一定能够买得起一把飞剑。
陈长生逛了趟修真集市，感觉自己就是最底层的贫民，啥也买不起。
更别提天道阁那种高端货，他现在连进都不敢进去。
这就是普通杂役弟子的窘况，大多数人都很穷，想要飞剑法宝？
简直门都没有，能够维持自己日常修炼就不错了。
“蒙脸布啊蒙脸布，元婴老怪都看不透，只要一千下品灵石。”

“咦？你这块蒙脸布当真是元婴期都看不穿么？”
陈长生来到一名中年修士的摊位，拿起一块黑布好奇问道，现在他不能暴露，如果能够隐藏自己的身份最好。
那摊主一看有生意上门，立即露出笑脸，“当然了，这位道友，这块蒙脸布可是一件宝物，能够隔绝神识，连元婴期都看不穿，不信我戴上你看看。”
陈长生点点头，“确实看不穿，不过我又不是元婴期。”
“呃……这位道友放心，我做生意一向都是童叟无欺，我说看不穿就看不穿，这样，五百块，五百你买不了吃亏，也买不了上当。”
“那行，三百我买了。”陈长生拿出三十枚聚气丹出来。
“好吧，这位道友，你年纪轻轻，没想到这么会砍价！三百我就交你这个朋友。”
陈长生给了丹药，找了个没人的地方，然后换了套衣服，把蒙脸布给戴上，又换了个地方，随即又从储物戒指里拿出一块桌布。
上面摆放了不少聚气丹，还有辟谷丹，甚至还有不少毒丹。
随即陈长生开始吆喝起来，“走过路过不要错过，兜卖聚气丹，辟谷丹和毒丹，价格童叟无欺，手快有，手慢无啦！”

> Chapter 19 Still Poor (Page 1)
The Qi Gathering Pill can not only be used directly for practice, but can also restore the five elements of spiritual energy in the body. Sometimes it is more useful than spiritual stones.
Chen Changsheng took out the Qi Gathering Pills and counted 170 of them. The monk sniffed them under his nostrils and nodded with satisfaction. Although the Qi Gathering Pills that Chen Changsheng refined were of low quality, they were also of first-class quality.
If the materials are better, Chen Changsheng believes that he can refine it with better quality.
Chen Changsheng took the elixir furnace and the elixir prescription and put it away with great satisfaction after scanning it with his spiritual mind.
The two pill recipes, Qi Gathering Pill and Bigu Pill, are the most common pill prescriptions. Anyone with a little knowledge can get them, so it is relatively easy to get them. Other pill prescriptions are probably very difficult to get.
Chen Changsheng even saw someone selling Foundation Establishment Pills, which made his breathing quicken. He was going to build a Foundation soon. If he had a Foundation Establishment Pill, the success rate would be greatly increased.
However, when Chen Changsheng saw the price, he was immediately deflated.
One foundation-building pill actually requires 100,000 low-grade spiritual stones, which is really terrifying.
I didn't expect the price of the Foundation Establishment Pill to be so high. If I could refine the Foundation Establishment Pill, wouldn't I be very prosperous?
Generally, the price of elixirs that can break through the great realms is very high, and this foundation-building elixir is a second-grade elixir, so the price is naturally ridiculously high.
There is also a pill that can break through the bottleneck and the price is also very high.
The more Chen Changsheng shopped around, the more enthused he became, but the price was also outrageous. This was just the most ordinary flying sword, and it cost 50,000 low-grade spiritual stones.
In other words, he may not be able to afford a flying sword after working in the Waste Pill Room for so long.
Chen Changsheng visited the cultivation market and felt that he was the poorest of the poor and could not afford anything.
Not to mention high-end products like Tiandao Pavilion, he doesn't even dare to enter now.
This is the plight of ordinary handyman disciples. Most of them are very poor. Want a flying sword magic weapon?
There is simply no way to do it. It would be nice to be able to maintain your daily practice.
"Mask the face cloth, cover the face cloth, even the Nascent Soul monster can't see through it. All it takes is a thousand low-grade spiritual stones."
"Eh? Are you really in the Nascent Soul stage and can't even see through this face covering?"
Chen Changsheng came to the stall of a middle-aged monk, picked up a piece of black cloth and asked curiously, he couldn't be exposed now, it would be best if he could hide his identity.
When the stall owner saw that there was business coming to his door, he immediately smiled and said, "Of course, fellow Taoist, this face covering is a treasure. It can block the consciousness. Even the Nascent Soul stage can't see through it. If you don't believe me, I'll put it on for you to see."
Chen Changsheng nodded, "It's true that I can't see through it, but I'm not in the Nascent Soul stage."
"Uh... Don't worry, fellow Taoist, I have always been honest in my business. If I say you can't see through it, you can't see through it. In this way, with five hundred yuan, you can't suffer a loss or be fooled."
"Okay, I'll buy three hundred." Chen Changsheng took out thirty Qi Gathering Pills.
"Okay, fellow Taoist, you are so young, I didn't expect you to be so good at bargaining! I will make you my friend for three hundred."
Chen Changsheng gave the elixir, found a place where no one was, then changed his clothes, put on the face covering, changed the place again, and then took out a tablecloth from the storage ring.
There are many Qi Gathering Pills, Bigu Pills, and even many Poison Pills placed on it.
Then Chen Changsheng started shouting, "Don't miss it if you pass by. They are selling Qi Gathering Pills, Bigu Pills and Poison Pills. The prices are reasonable. If you are quick, you will get it, but if you are slow, you will lose it!"
